name: @projexlight/sdk-ai-gateway
summary: Multi-provider LLM gateway for ProjexCloud agents. Wraps Anthropic / OpenAI / Bedrock / Gemini behind one interface, routes requests by route_rule (tenant policy + cost + latency), strips PII via configurable redaction rules before egress, meters tokens through sdk-meter, signs every completion into the audit chain. The substrate every AI-touching SDK and the cloud builder agent sits on top of.

endpoints.description: Liveness probe; confirms every required provider is reachable + capability-token signing key loaded.
Non-streaming completion. Returns the full message + usage + provider + route_rule_id used.
Streaming completion via SSE. Same shape as complete but delta tokens stream as they arrive.

events.name: ai-gateway.completion.v1
events.description: Every completion (streaming or not) writes one event at end-of-response; carries provider + model + usage + redaction_decisions.

events.name: ai-gateway.redaction.applied.v1
events.description: PII / PHI redaction rule fired on egress. Carries rule_id + count_redacted.

events.name: ai-gateway.route.flipped.v1
events.description: Route rule updated (provider switch, cost ceiling change). Cache invalidation broadcast.

events.name: ai-gateway.provider.degraded.v1
events.description: Provider health probe failed; route_rule fallback engaged.

models.description: Per-provider config: name (anthropic/openai/bedrock/gemini), api_base, signing-key vault ref, health_status.
Per-(tenant, intent) routing: which provider + model, cost ceiling, latency target, fallback chain.
Per-completion log: tenant, persona, intent, provider, model, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, latency_ms.
Regex + ML-classifier rules; pre-egress redaction with reversible tokenization for round-trippable redaction.

hooks.name: complete
hooks.description: Universal completion entry. Picks provider + model from the route_rule, applies redaction, meters tokens, signs audit.

hooks.name: stream
hooks.description: Streaming variant returning an AsyncIterable of token deltas + a final usage object.

hooks.name: registerProvider
hooks.description: Wire a new provider adapter (Anthropic / OpenAI / Bedrock / Gemini / custom).

hooks.name: addRedactionRule
hooks.description: Add a tenant-scoped PII / PHI redaction rule; pre-egress + post-ingress symmetry.

scenarios.title: Cloud-builder agent generates scaffold instructions via the gateway
scenarios.when_to_use: The E6 cloud builder agent calls complete() for every reasoning step. Routing picks the cheapest model that satisfies the tenant's quality + latency targets.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Returns { message, usage, provider, model, route_rule_id }. Emits ai-gateway.completion.v1 to the audit chain. Tokens metered via sdk-meter under the ai-gateway.completion SKU.

scenarios.title: PII auto-redacted before being sent to the provider
scenarios.when_to_use: Healthcare or FinServ tenant; PHI / PII can never leak to a third-party LLM. The pre-egress redactor strips it; tokens flow back through the reverse map on response.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Provider never sees the SSN. Emits ai-gateway.redaction.applied.v1 with count. Response surface has the original SSN restored from the reverse map (or stays redacted if reversal disabled).

scenarios.title: Route rule caps tenant spend by downgrading to a cheaper model
scenarios.when_to_use: Tenant's monthly LLM budget is exhausting; route_rule auto-downgrades from gpt-4-class to a cheaper model until reset.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Cost cap respected automatically. Emits ai-gateway.route.flipped.v1 with reason='cost-cap'. Tenant admin sees the warning on the Billing page.

scenarios.title: Provider degraded → automatic failover to backup
scenarios.when_to_use: Anthropic API returns 5xx; route_rule's fallback chain engages without the agent caller seeing the disruption.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Caller's complete() succeeds via the fallback provider. Result carries the actual provider used so observability can attribute traffic correctly.

scenarios.title: Stream tokens for an interactive chat UI
scenarios.when_to_use: Cloud-builder UI streams tokens as they arrive for snappy feedback.
scenarios.expected_outcome: AsyncIterable yields incremental tokens; a final delta carries the usage object. Single ai-gateway.completion.v1 event at end-of-stream (not per-token).

compliance_posture.notes: Provider keys vault-wrapped; never in plaintext env vars in production. Egress redaction is the HIPAA / GDPR safeguard — a misconfiguration here is a data-protection incident. EU AI Act logging satisfied by ai-gateway.completion.v1 per-call. Customers in regulated jurisdictions may pin route_rule to providers in-region only (e.g. Bedrock eu-west-1).

pricing_skus.unit_description: per completion (provider cost passthrough + ProjexCloud platform fee)
per streaming session (priced identically to completion)
per redaction rule fired (free in healthcare/finserv packs)
